issues.legal_issue: A certificate based only on the value of the property does not permit a Supreme Court appeal when an appellate bench has affirmed a single judge’s decision and no substantial question of law has been certified.
material_facts: The appeal to the Supreme Court followed a decision of an appellate bench affirming a single judge’s judgment.
The High Court issued a certificate based on the value of the property involved but did not certify that the case involved a substantial question of law.
issues.conclusion: The certificate was insufficient and the appeal could not be entertained. The Court dismissed the appeal and declined to grant special leave.
issues.legal_principle: Under Article 133(1) of the Constitution, “the Court immediately below” means the court from whose decision the appeal is filed, not merely a court subordinate to the High Court. When an appellate bench affirms a single judge’s judgment, a certificate based on property value alone is insufficient without certification of a substantial question of law. The Court relied on Ladli Prasad Jaiswal v. The Karnal Distillery Company Ltd., referred to Toolsey Persaud Bhuckt v. Benayek Misser and Probhawati Kunwar v. Panmal Lodha, and rejected the approach in Deoki Nandan v. State of Uttar Pradesh.

rule.if: supreme_court_certificate_appeal and single_judge_judgment_affirmed_by_appellate_bench and certificate_based_only_on_property_value and no_substantial_question_of_law_certified

predicates.supreme_court_certificate_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal to the Supreme Court brought on the basis of a certificate.
predicates.single_judge_judgment_affirmed_by_appell: An appellate bench affirmed the judgment of a single judge.
predicates.certificate_based_only_on_property_value: The certificate relied on the value of the property involved as the basis for the appeal.
predicates.no_substantial_question_of_law_certified: The certifying court did not certify that the case involved a substantial question of law.

issues.definition: When a certified Supreme Court appeal follows an appellate bench’s affirmance of a single judge’s judgment, a certificate based only on property value and lacking certification of a substantial question of law makes the appeal not entertainable.
